text:
maria_support: Heads-up — customer reported an AWS Marketplace invoice that doesn't match our internal usage for acct 987654321. AWS line items show ~18,000 minute-usage for sku 'redwood-infer-mini' on 2026-02-28, but our token-metering only shows ~200k tokens (expected ~1,800 minutes).

maria_support: Repro steps I followed: 1) pulled AWS billing CSV export for invoice INV-2026-02-28; 2) filtered SKU column for 'redwood-infer-mini'; 3) summed usageQuantity. Attached a tiny sample below.

maria_support: ```
bill_date,sku,usageQuantity,resourceTag:tenant_id,aws_line_item_id
2026-02-28,redwood-infer-mini,18000,tenant_342,LI-0a1b2c3
2026-02-28,redwood-infer-mini,17500,tenant_342,LI-0d4e5f6
```

marketplace-bot: Parsed invoice INV-2026-02-28: detected marketplace SKU redwood-infer-mini, total usageQuantity=35500 minutes, billable units aggregated by AWS. Matched to internal tenant_342 via tag.

tanvi_billing: Thanks Maria — can you paste the AWS Marketplace ProductCode + Account ID and the invoice number? Also want the raw line_item_id(s).

maria_support: ProductCode=prd-RED-INF-MINI, AWS account=123456789012, invoice=INV-2026-02-28, line items: LI-0a1b2c3, LI-0d4e5f6.

olivia_customer: FYI — saw a big charge on the invoice. We only ran a single test suite that day, shouldn't be 600+ hours. Please escalate.

dinesh_eng: Quick note — our usage exporter runs a minute-aggregation job that maps token counts -> billed minutes for marketplace breakdown. I pulled the exporter logs for tenant_342 on 2026-02-28 and saw the job re-run at 00:05 UTC and again at 00:20 UTC with near-identical inputs. Suspect duplicate aggregation wrote two sets of minute rows to the reporting bucket.

maria_support: dinesh, can you paste the log snippet and estimated duplicate minutes?

dinesh_eng: ```
2026-02-28T00:05:12Z INFO export: tenant=tenant_342 source=usage_agg job_id=agg-20260228-1 minutes=17500 tokens=200123
2026-02-28T00:20:17Z INFO export: tenant=tenant_342 source=usage_agg job_id=agg-20260228-1 DUPLICATE minutes=17500 tokens=200123
```

dinesh_eng: So ~17.5k minutes duplicated -> AWS shows ~35.5k. Root cause: our dedupe check keyed on (tenant, date, job_id) but the job_id was reused because a retry didn't bump the id due to a race with the scheduler. Fix in flight.

tanvi_billing: That explains the delta. Henry, estimate of $ impact? Also need to know whether AWS is billing us twice or just presenting aggregated minutes (we bill customers based on their marketplace usage mapping).

henry_finance: Ballpark — redwood-infer-mini list price $0.03/min -> 17,500 extra minutes ~ $525. We should calculate exact amounts after mapping to our revenue share with AWS. If customer was overcharged, we'll credit.

olivia_customer: Appreciate the quick diagnosis. Do you need anything from our side? We can confirm we did one test run only.

maria_support: No, thanks — we have the evidence. Next steps: 1) engineering will remove duplicate rows from the reporting S3 prefix and re-run the invoice join; 2) billing will reconcile and issue credit if invoice was already paid; 3) patch exporter to ensure job_id uniqueness.

tanvi_billing: For reconciliation I need the corrected per-tenant consumption CSV. Dinesh can you run the quick Athena query on the raw meter files and drop corrected CSV to s3://redwood-billing-corrections/tenant_342/INV-2026-02-28-corrected.csv

dinesh_eng: Athena query I used: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, date, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(minutes) as minutes
FROM "marketplace_raw"
WHERE date = '2026-02-28' AND tenant_id = 'tenant_342'
GROUP BY tenant_id, date;
```

dinesh_eng: I pushed corrected CSV to s3://redwood-billing-corrections/tenant_342/INV-2026-02-28-corrected.csv and triggered the invoice join job (run id join-20260228-fix).

marketplace-bot: Re-run result for INV-2026-02-28: corrected usageQuantity=18000 minutes (single set). Delta vs published invoice = -17500 minutes.

tanvi_billing: Received corrected CSV. I'll coordinate with finance to produce a credit memo if the customer has already been charged. Henry, please confirm final amt after AWS rev-share reclaim.

henry_finance: Will calculate and confirm by EOD. If invoice unpaid, we will adjust before settlement. If paid, we will issue credit and notify customer. Estimate net impact after rev-share ~ $320.

olivia_customer: Thank you — please let me know when credit is issued or invoice corrected.

maria_support: Internal follow-ups: engineering PR to enforce UUID job_id and add idempotency check (PR #2987), ops task to scan last 7 days for duplicates, billing to issue credit if necessary.

dinesh_eng: PR merged and deployed canary to staging. Ops scan found only this tenant/date pair affected.

tanvi_billing: Finance confirmed credit of $325 gross (pre-rev-share) to be applied to tenant_342's account or refunded per client preference. I'll open a support ticket to confirm refund vs account credit.

olivia_customer: Refund please. Opened ticket CASE-2026-334.

maria_support: Closing the thread—root cause duplicate aggregation during reporting retry; correction done, credit arranged. Will follow up if ops scan finds more. :white_check_mark:
